description: A process's counts over a stretch (about a minute): what was used and run in it, each once with its count and time. Kept by its machine's host as it's told, read back with telemetry_read.

at.description: When the stretch ended, in seconds since the epoch.

counts.description: Each thing used or run in it, the most times first.

commit.description: The commit the process runs (its first 12 characters).

span.description: A rolled-up row's: the seconds it stands for (3600: a row an hour, after a week), its counts added up (null: a row a minute, as told).
